item.title: How to Integrate Kata into a Kubernetes Cluster
item.description: 1. What Problem Kata Solves Security and isolation are what make Kata Container stand out from Docker Container. Kata Container comes from the merger of the Intel Clear Containers and Hyper runV projects. Intel Clear Containers used Intel VT-x technology to provide containers through lightweight virtual machines, solving the security problem while delivering excellent performance.
